001: Hey Lucas, did you have a good weekend?
I visited an exhibition, it was really interesting.
Oh really? You'll have to tell me about it, I love that kind of outing.
With pleasure, we can talk about it during the lunch break.
Perfect, I'll bring you a coffee and you can tell me everything.
002: Have you seen the new project manager?
Yes, I ran into him this morning in the hallway.
He seems pretty nice, doesn't he?
He seemed very professional to me, at any rate.
I hope we'll get along well with him.
Me too, it always changes the atmosphere a bit.
003: Say, are you having lunch with us today?
I'd love to, but I'm finishing a report before noon.
No problem, we can wait about fifteen minutes.
That's nice of you, I'll be quick, promise.
Should we try that new Italian restaurant near the office?
Totally, I've heard a lot of good things about it.
004: Don't you think the meeting room is too small?
Yeah, honestly, we're cramped when there are a lot of us.
I wonder if we could book a bigger one.
Good idea, we'd need to ask at the front desk.
I'll take care of it in a bit, then.
Thanks, it's really more pleasant to work comfortably.
005: Did you manage to make progress on the Martin file?
Yes, I've almost finished the financial part.
Do you need a hand with the rest?
That would be great, I'm struggling with the charts.
No problem, I'll show you a trick.
Oh, you're a lifesaver, I hate that kind of task.
006: Do you know if tomorrow's meeting is still on?
I think so, but the time might have changed.
Oh really? Did you get an email about it?
Yes, I saw it a little while ago, we start at ten o'clock.
Perfect, thanks for the info, I'll make a note of that.
You're welcome, see you tomorrow then.
007: Do you have any plans for the summer holidays?
I'm thinking of going to Brittany with my family.
That's a beautiful region, have you been before?
Yes, I used to go there often when I was little.
You'll be lucky, the weather is nice there.
I hope so, we need some rest after this busy semester.
008: Have you seen the new software we have to use?
Yes, I watched the tutorial last night.
Do you find it complicated to get the hang of?
Not really, it looks like the old one, actually.
Good to hear, I was afraid I'd have to learn everything again.
No, don't worry, you'll get the hang of it very quickly.
009: Are you coming to the team party on Friday?
I don't know yet, I need to check my schedule.
It would be great if you came, we'll all be there.
Okay, I'll give you my answer tomorrow morning.
Perfect, I hope you can make it.
Me too, it's been a while since we've done something together.
010: Have you heard from Sophie, is she still out?
Yes, she's been sick for a few days now.
I hope it's nothing too serious.
No, just a bad flu, she needs some rest.
We should send her a little message.
Good idea, it'll make her happy, I'm sure of it.
